settings.title: Payroll system and payroll period
settings.description: The payroll system determines the columns in the export file (see docs/PAYROLL-EXPORT.md). The payroll period drives the suggested period when exporting.

wageTypes.title: Pay codes
wageTypes.description: The payroll system's pay codes that hours and absence are translated into. Supplements are added on top of the base pay code, e.g. weekend supplements on top of standard hours.
wageTypes.name: Name
wageTypes.empty: No pay codes yet. Create e.g. 0100 Standard hours, 0200 Overtime, 0300 Sickness (days).

rules.title: Mapping rules
rules.description: What is translated into which pay code. The lowest priority wins; on a tie the most specific rule wins (specific type and day condition). Without a rule, the type's fallback code below is used.
rules.needWageType: Create at least one pay code before making rules.
rules.empty: No rules. Without rules only the fallback codes on activity and absence types are used.

fallback.title: Fallback codes on types
fallback.description: Used when no mapping rule matches. Hours from activity types are exported in hours, absence in days. Save with Enter or by leaving the field.

employees.title: Employee numbers
employees.description: The employee's number in the payroll system (without CPR number, unique within the organisation). The external ID is used by SD Løn as the service number.
employees.missing: {count, plural, one {# active employee is missing an employee number.} other {# active employees are missing an employee number.}}

export.title: Payroll period export
export.description: Hours and days per pay code per employee for the period, ready to import into the payroll system. The same figures as the payroll report in the report builder.

page.title: Payroll and pay codes
page.intro: Translate logged hours, absence and overtime into the payroll system's pay codes, and export one flat file per payroll period that the payroll office can import. The mapping is deterministic: the same data always gives the same file.
page.readOnly: Read-only access. The setup can only be changed by an administrator. Export is still available at the bottom.
